about: Known-answer test bank for scalegeom. 'published' values come from Vaz (2026), Geographical Analysis 58: e70061; 'data' values check the bundled open datasets against their sources; 'regression' values were pinned on 2026-11-07 so that later changes to the code are noticed. A change to a regression value must be explained in CHANGELOG.md.

scenario_A_exits.source: Section 9.8, single correlation length stays in the band

scenario_B_exits.source: Section 9.8, exits at six of seven scales

nc_income_county_var_retained.note: unweighted variance of county values over unweighted variance of tract values

nc_income_zoning_null_z_var.note: changed in 0.2.0: weighted variance; the default zoning null now matches zone sizes and contiguity

nc_income_county_var_retained_weighted.note: population-weighted variance (between-county share), the default since 0.2.0
